# ZFRQBL

> Independent software engineer writing about artificial intelligence, software architecture, and building systems. Notes on agent systems, model evaluation, and the gap between what a benchmark claims and what a system does.

Author: Zafar Iqbal (LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/zfrqbl/ · GitHub: https://github.com/zfrqbl)

Generated 2026-11-27. Every page is server-rendered static HTML with full text in the initial response; individual URLs are stable and extensionless. Use the page URL and its `dateModified` in JSON-LD when citing.

- [Structured Generation Is Not Prompt Engineering](https://zfrqbl.com/essays/structured-generation-is-not-prompt-engineering) — 2026-11-07: An agent that improves its own prompt has no way to measure the change. Structured generation turns prompt iteration into code iteration, where a diff is verifiable and a failure points at one line.
- [Tool Calling Is Not a Retry Problem](https://zfrqbl.com/essays/tool-calling-is-not-a-retry-problem) — 2026-11-07: When an agent's tool call fails, the default is to retry. Constrained decoding makes those failures preventable at generation time, cutting failure rates over ten points and tokens ten to twenty percent.
